summary: Converts a zero-based column index into its letter.
description: Indices count from zero, the way a `GridRange` does; positions count from one, the way `getRange(row, column)` does. Mixing the two is the usual source of an off-by-one in a spreadsheet script, which is why both pairs exist under separate names.

params.index: The zero-based column index. `0` is column A.
